I am the head of programs at Tennis Australia and I'm looking forward to sharing the next 25 or so minutes with you to talk about data and insights to help drive programming locally in your clubs and centres. But before I start today I would like to acknowledge the custodians of the land I am on, the people of the Kulin Nations and pay my respects to Elders past and present and to all First Nations people listening with us here today.
